summary: Iteration 5 verified 3 new features + regressions. Backend: 24/24 pytest pass in 12.31s. Added 3 new tests: (a) SiteSettings defaults include card_size='md', card_height=180, animation='none'; (b) settings.animation='glow' + card_size='custom' + card_height=260 persist via PUT and are returned in /api/public/resolve; (c) per-card badge_text/badge_color/animation persist through POST /api/sites/{id}/cards and PUT /api/cards/{id}, exposed in public payload; empty badge_text stays falsy. Playwright UI: logged in, opened SiteEditor Görünüm tab -> set-animation, set-card-size present. Selecting 'Özel (px)' revealed set-card-height (slider) and set-card-height-input; changed height to 300 and animation to Parıltı (glow), clicked Kaydet -> API confirmed card_size=custom, card_height=300, animation=glow persisted. Opened Kolonlar tab -> add-card-btn -> card dialog: card-title-input, card-link-input, card-border-style, card-badge-text, card-animation, save-card-btn all present. Filled title 'UITestCard', link, badge_text 'YENİ' and saved -> POST /api/sites/{id}/cards returned 200 and card persisted with badge_text='YENİ'; live preview immediately rendered a rotated corner ribbon (screenshot). Public page /site/demo (seeded by main agent) confirmed rendering: 6 .anim-wrap all with .anim-glow class, and 3 .card-badge ribbons: 'YENİ' (rgb(34,197,94)/green), 'VIP' (rgb(250,204,21)/yellow), '%100 BONUS' (rgb(239,68,68)/red); document.title still reflects settings.page_title 'DAYKO - Güncel Giriş'. All prior regressions (login, CRUD, reorder, publish, upload, duplicate, domain resolve, click redirect, border/gradient/neon styles, casino bg preset) still pass.

critical_code_review_comments: SiteSettings correctly defaults card_size='md', card_height=180, animation='none' - Pydantic model_dump keeps these on GET.
CardInput.animation is Optional (None = inherit) - PublicSiteRenderer computes effective anim = c.animation || s.animation, correct fallback.
public_site_payload exposes badge_text, badge_color, animation per card - verified via /api/public/resolve.
PublicSiteRenderer minH uses card_height only when card_size==='custom' - verified in code and preview.
CSS keyframes cardPulse/cardFloat/cardGlow + .anim-* + .card-badge exist; respects prefers-reduced-motion (good).
Note: unused local file /app/backend/tests/__pycache__ persists across runs but has no impact.
